support_claim: CRM row VEL-19 names the account as Vellum Print Co and billing records a billed name of Vellum Print Co Ltd, but no observation explicitly links these referents as the same or as distinct legal counterparties.
justification: Under the relation contract, SAME_ENTITY requires establishing evidence of identity and DISTINCT requires establishing evidence of distinctness; name similarity between Vellum Print Co and Vellum Print Co Ltd is insufficient for SAME_ENTITY, and the packet provides no positive evidence that the CRM account and billing name denote different legal counterparties, so neither burden is met.
